title: OpenPoet Automation API v1 Command Envelope

idempotency_key.description: Alternative to the Idempotency-Key header. If both are sent, they must match.

actor.description: Accepted for connector compatibility but never trusted. The effective actor always comes from the bearer token.

expected_version.description: Optimistic concurrency version for work-run transitions and plan upserts. Other capabilities return expected_version_unsupported.

correlation_id.description: For platform policy approvals, a canonical audit reference is required. For explicit approvals, it must also equal the grant authorization_ref (ain:, inbound:, signal:, task:, or policy:).

approval_token.description: One-time approval grant issued by POST /approvals and bound to this bearer client, capability, command_id, and correlation_id authorization evidence.
